title: Rib-related Pain: Rib Dysfunction, Costochondritis and Rib Fracture
case: Presentation (from the chapter): Sharp, localised chest wall pain reproduced by pressing on a specific spot. Pain with deep breathing, coughing, sneezing, twisting, reaching.
working: Rib-related Pain: Rib Dysfunction, Costochondritis and Rib Fracture
plan: Track pain with deep breath, palpation tenderness, and function. Fractures usually heal over about 6 weeks [Ref – to verify]; progress upper body loading after pain settles.

differentials.name: Acute coronary syndrome
differentials.key: Exertional, sweating, radiation to arm or jaw

qa: Is reproduction on palpation enough to diagnose costochondritis? No. Cardiac causes must be excluded first in at-risk adults.
Why encourage deep breathing after a rib fracture? Shallow breathing increases risk of lung collapse and pneumonia.
What differentiates Tietze from costochondritis? Visible swelling.
A patient has lower rib pain with a click when bending. Which test? Hooking manoeuvre.
Why avoid tight chest binding? It restricts breathing and increases pneumonia risk.

fields.Procedure: Firm pressure on each costochondral joint
fields.Finding and meaning: Exactly reproduces the familiar pain: supports costochondritis
fields.Next step: Still screen cardiac causes in adults with risk factors

fields.Procedure: Gently compress the ribcage front to back and side to side
fields.Finding and meaning: Sharp localised pain away from the hands: possible fracture
fields.Next step: Avoid manual therapy; medical review if trauma

fields.Procedure: Supine; curl fingers under the lower costal margin and pull forward
fields.Finding and meaning: Reproduces pain and click: slipping rib syndrome

fields.Procedure: Prone; gentle anterior pressure at rib angle
fields.Finding and meaning: Local pain: posterior rib joint dysfunction

redFlags.Finding: Chest pain with sweating, breathlessness, arm or jaw radiation
Sudden breathlessness after trauma, reduced breath sounds
Multiple rib fractures, paradoxical chest movement
Fracture after minimal force in older adult

manualNotes: Education is the main treatment for costochondritis: it is benign, often settles over weeks to months [Ref – to verify].
Manual therapy: posterior rib and thoracic mobilisation for rib dysfunction; avoid direct pressure on acute fractures.
Exercise: thoracic mobility, deep breathing, gradual upper body loading; temporarily reduce provoking activities (for example heavy pushing).
Rib fracture: pain control (doctor), deep breathing exercises every hour while awake, supported cough (hug a pillow), early walking to prevent chest infection. Do not bind the chest tightly.
Modalities: heat or ice for comfort; not essential.
